ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 remains in the pinned Node 24.22.3 Alpine 3.23 and Go 1.27.4 Alpine 3.23 FROM images (zlib 1.3.2-r1; fixed in 1.4-r0). Both production build stages install zlib>=1.4-r0 before project build commands, and fail if that fixed package is unavailable; Nox inventories the FROM image rather than the resulting stage. The Go runtime is scratch and the frontend build stage is not shipped. This carries forward the existing accepted base-image finding; it is not evidence the upstream images are fixed. Tracked in https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/58; remove when the pinned FROM digests contain zlib >=1.4-r0.
